question.text: Which of the following is a LEGITIMATE commercial reason for a sponsor to use a PARALLEL structure instead of master-feeder?

answer.text: To charge 20x management fees on each dollar of commitment

To place large investors (who negotiate reduced fees) in one offshore vehicle and standard-fee investors in another, and to allow offshore investors to opt-out of individual investees for legal/tax reasons
To avoid paying any taxes anywhere in the world

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Genuine reasons for parallel include: (a) different investor tiers (reduced-fee anchors vs. standard-fee investors in separate vehicles); (b) offshore investors opting out of specific investees for their own legal/tax reasons; (c) tax-treatment benefits for offshore investors in specific jurisdictions. The workbook cites these explicitly. **The Trap:** Options A, C, D are fabricated / illegal motivations. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C/D cover these rationales; XIX-E tests them in Cat III framing. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** If you use parallel for fee-tiering, be explicit in both PPMs about which vehicle an investor is in and why — fee-differences must be defensible under SEBI's unfair-advantage standards.
